# Hash-locked Quarto rendering dependencies for CI.
# Full transitive closure of nbclient==0.10.2 + ipykernel==6.29.5 for
# Linux x86_64 / Python 3.13. Intentionally separate from runtime lockfiles.
# Regenerate with:
#   pip download nbclient==X ipykernel==Y -d /tmp/pkgs \
#     --python-version 3.13 --only-binary :all: \
#     --platform manylinux_2_17_x86_64
#   pip hash --algorithm sha256 /tmp/pkgs/*.whl
# packaging is held at 25.0, the version environments/requirements-ci.txt
# pins: ci.yml's test job installs this file into the same environment, and
# snakemake 9.27.0 and snakemake-interface-common 1.23.0 declare packaging<26.
# The recipe above resolves the newest packaging; re-pin it to 25.0.
